plan.title: Hallmark pathway activity scores UC vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: The question asks for one pathway activity score per sample and a hallmark heatmap separating UC inflamed (treated) from control. Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 x 13) need sample-structure QC first (sample_01 has ~4x below-median library size — kept and reported, not silently dropped), a minimal low-count pre-filter, and DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors with variance-stabilized log-normalized values as the scoring input. Per-sample pathway activity is computed with GSVA over the 50 MSigDB Hallmark sets (h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt, staged in the reference store), because GSVA is the designated method for a matrix of many sets across a fixed sample set tested by limma. Pathways are tested between UC_inflamed and control with a moderated t-test on the score matrix under the same two-group design, BH-adjusted across the 50 signatures, and delivered as a per-sample score table plus a sample x pathway heatmap with the significant, discriminating pathways highlighted.
